what_it_does.text: NanoHalen Oy is a portfolio company registered on 2023-10-23 under the industry code 26510, manufacture of instruments and appliances for measuring, testing and navigation.

thesis_fit.text: It is a declared portfolio company, and the memo reads thesis fit as Medium.

readiness.text: On the radar's rules technology readiness is level 4, business readiness is level 4 and investment readiness is level 3.

who_to_meet.text: The who-comes-next lists name Korkia as an investor, Baltic Sea Action Plan as a programme or funding source and ABB Marine & Ports as a partner.

what_the_fund_should_do.text: The memo puts it on the watchlist (ocean impact unknown, business readiness Medium, investment readiness Low, thesis fit Medium), so the fund should reassess it when a new public record appears.

whats_missing.text: Gaps on the record: no public evidence for ocean impact; investment readiness is Low on the stored evidence; no public market evidence (public buyers in the category).
